about_intro: Practise your group's songs: the sheet and the recording together, the recording slowed down with its pitch kept.
about_demo: This online version is a demonstration. For regular or wide use, please run your own copy: the source code is open on GitHub.
about_signin: You sign in on Microsoft's own sign-in page. Downtempo never sees your password.
about_kept: The sign-in is kept only in this browser, on this device.
about_reads: Downtempo opens only the shared folders you add, and only reads them. Microsoft asks permission to read and write your OneDrive, because a personal account needs it to open a shared link; Downtempo writes nothing there.
about_copies: The files are copied only into this browser's own storage, on this device.
about_no_server: There is no Downtempo server. The app talks only to Microsoft, for the sign-in and your files; nothing you open, play or set is sent anywhere else, and nothing is tracked.
about_remove: In Settings, Delete the project removes its files from this device, and Sign out ends the sign-in. Clearing this site's data in your browser removes everything.
intro_how_1: Someone in your group keeps the songs (sheets and recordings) in a shared OneDrive folder.
intro_how_2: You create a project in Downtempo that holds the folder's share link.
intro_how_3: Downtempo reads the folder's contents, and you choose the folders of the project that hold the sheets and the audio.
intro_trust_1: It never sees your password: you sign in on Microsoft's own page.
intro_trust_2: It only reads the folders you add, and changes nothing in OneDrive.
intro_trust_3: There is no Downtempo server: nothing is uploaded or tracked. The files stay on this device.
link_why_title: Why does Downtempo ask for a link?
link_why_what: The link is the address of a shared OneDrive folder.
link_why_how: After this step Microsoft asks you to sign in. Then Downtempo reads the files in that folder and copies the ones you pick into this browser.
link_help: What is a OneDrive link? Microsoft's guide to sharing
empty_why: This project has no shared folder yet, so there is nothing to download. When your group leader sends you the OneDrive link, add it here and the songs come in.
link_why_who: In OneDrive, whoever shares a folder chooses who may open it: anyone who has the link, or only chosen people. For the second kind, sign in with the Microsoft account the link was shared with.
intro_storage: The files go into your browser's private storage for this site (origin private file system), a standard feature alongside the ordinary cache, in browsers since 2023. The songs work without a network, and only this site can see them.
